_comment: Controls for games no database knows (PC ports, homebrew). Key = '<RetroFE collection>/<item>' as the game list names it. Fields are games.json 'controls' fields: players, ways, joystick, buttons, labels, wheel, trackball, spinner, lightgun, flightStick. A wheel game gets GAS / BRAKE on buttons 1-2 automatically (stick steers), then its own buttons. A cabinet can add its own <manifest>\panel-controls-overrides.json. Re-run tools\New-PanelControlsArt.py after editing.
